description: Permissions for the launcher and tool windows (least privilege: only the window APIs the frontend calls). Tool windows are labelled modbus-master-<n> by window_open_tool; native poll windows modbus-master-<n>-poll-<pollId> (BE-002), also matched by modbus-master-*. They use the same window APIs (setTitle, onCloseRequested, destroy). App commands (mm_*, profiles_*, window_open_tool, app_list_monitors) need no capability entry.
